描述_EN: a green glaze was then splashed onto the cream background. the exact origin of this stoneware bottle is unknown, but its shape and splashes of green glaze are typical of the kilns in northern china during the liao (907-1125) and northern song (960-1127) dynasties.the body of this pot was first formed and then covered with a cream-coloured slip (a layer of diluted firing clay) in order give an even colour to the entire surface. this technique was practiced at several kilns in northern china at the time, and had been practiced since the 6th century ad.
描述_ZN: 然后在奶油色的背景上泼上绿色的釉。 这个炻器瓶的确切来源不详，但它的形状和飞溅的绿釉是辽代（907-1125）和北宋（960-1127）时期中国北方窑场的典型特征。这个壶的壶身首先成型，然后用奶油色的滑液（一层稀释的烧制粘土）覆盖，以使整个表面颜色均匀。 这种技术在当时的中国北方的几个窑场都有应用，并且从公元6世纪就开始实施了。
